bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to state government; designating iron ore as the state mineral; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 1.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[1.1467] STATE MINERAL. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Iron ore.+]

[+Iron ore is the official mineral of the state of Minnesota. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Photograph.+]

[+A photograph and a typical specimen of iron ore shall be preserved in the Office of the Secretary of State. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; designating iron ore as the state mineral; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 1.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[1.1467] STATE MINERAL.

Subdivision 1.

Iron ore.

Iron ore is the official mineral of the state of Minnesota.

Subd. 2.

Photograph.

A photograph and a typical specimen of iron ore shall be preserved in the Office of the Secretary of State.
additions: Iron ore is the official mineral of the state of Minnesota.
A photograph and a typical specimen of iron ore shall be preserved in the Office of the Secretary of State.
